  2. Round 1 · Claude Code

    Changed the app

    The Google tag was hardcoded in every page's <head> and loaded straight away, so it ran before any choice and the site had no way to decline.

    In server.js I removed that static tag and added an Accept/Decline banner. The tag now loads only when the stored choice is "accepted", or right after the visitor clicks Accept. On first visit, and after Decline, nothing loads. node --check server.js passes, but I haven't run the app or re-run Kane against it.

The rule

When a visitor refuses cookies, no advertising or analytics tracker may load, before the choice or after it, and no visitor ID may be sent to a tracker.

Why it matters
  • ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC, Art. 5(3): storing or reading non-essential data on a device needs prior consent
  • GDPR (EU) 2016/679, Art. 4(11) and Art. 7: consent must be freely given and as easy to withdraw as to give
  • California Civil Code §1798.120 (CCPA/CPRA): consumers may opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information
